briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Zalympix Glow-Up Meets DEA Speed Bump: Michigan Cannabis Keeps Winning While D.C. Untangles Rescheduling
briefs.top: Michigan's cultivators just took home the state's top cannabis honors and distressed real estate is creating rock-bottom entry points for expansion, even as the 24% wholesale tax keeps generating political heat and a fresh gubernatorial tax-cut pledge. Nationally, Compass Pathways' psilocybin program is barreling toward a possible late-2026 FDA approval and Eli Lilly just closed a major psychedelics acquisition, while a DEA rescheduling pause is framed by insiders as a process fix, not a dead end.

local.text: Mitten Canna Co. and Hytek sweep Zalympix
local.detail: Mitten Canna Co.'s Toad Venom won best overall flower and Hytek's Oishii Piña took best overall live rosin at Michigan's 'Grammys of Cannabis' awards night at the Crofoot in Pontiac.

local.text: Sixth Circuit wipes out $31.8M Curaleaf judgment
local.detail: Federal appeals judges reportedly voided a $31.8 million cannabis contract judgment against Curaleaf subsidiaries, a rare courtroom win for a major Michigan operator this month.

local.text: Distressed cannabis real estate is a buyer's market
local.detail: At least 50 Michigan cannabis properties are now up for sale or lease with brokers pricing deals at 20 to 30 cents on the dollar, opening cheap expansion room for well-capitalized operators.

local.text: Gubernatorial candidate pledges to cut wholesale tax
local.detail: GOP candidate John James has pledged to slash Michigan's 24% wholesale weed tax and picked up endorsements from top cannabis executives, though Sen. Jeff Irwin is urging the industry to be skeptical of the promise.

local.text: MiCIA escalates fight against 24% wholesale tax
local.detail: Michigan Cannabis Industry Association spokesperson Robin Schneider says two members died by suicide in the past month as the industry struggles under the new tax, intensifying pressure on Lansing for relief.

national.text: Compass Pathways psilocybin nears historic FDA approval
national.detail: COMP360 has produced durable 26-week Phase 3 data and a rolling NDA submission on track for completion in Q4 2026, putting the first classic psychedelic therapy on pace for FDA approval by late 2026 or early 2027.

national.text: Eli Lilly closes major psychedelics acquisition
national.detail: Lilly's acquisition of atai Beckley assets closed September 11, bringing BPL-003, VLS-01 and EMP-01 under a pharma giant's umbrella just days after the FDA published its new psychedelic drug framework.

national.text: DEA hits pause on rescheduling to fix the process
national.detail: A DEA judge stayed the marijuana rescheduling hearing after a GAO report found 'gaps' in federal scheduling procedures, setting an October 13 deadline for the government's response rather than killing the effort.

national.text: States banked $3.55 billion in cannabis taxes
national.detail: The U.S. Census Bureau reports states and D.C. collected an estimated $3.55 billion in cannabis excise taxes between July 2025 and June 2026 as legal markets keep expanding.

national.text: Medical cannabis legitimacy keeps climbing nationally
national.detail: New American College of Physicians studies count nearly 4 million registered medical marijuana patients, at least 35,000 authorized clinicians and almost 110,000 caregivers, even as teen use hits a 30-year low.
